release_read.basis: Q3 net sales $1.2B (+60% y/y) vs a $1.10-1.14B guide and ~$1.13B consensus, non-GAAP EPS $1.46 vs $1.21-1.27 guided and ~$1.22-1.25 consensus, book-to-bill 2.13; FY26 raised to $4.47-4.49B / EPS $4.97-5.03 and a first preliminary FY27 of $6.5-6.75B / EPS $8.10-8.90, roughly 12x on a ~$100 stock. Q4 guide $1.42-1.44B includes Epiq/STG, so organic Q4 is less clean than the headline, which caps it near the option-implied move rather than far beyond it.

release.headline: TTM Technologies, Inc. reports third quarter 2026 results (record net sales $1.2B, +60% y/y)

key_line.metric: Q4 guide and first FY27 outlook
key_line.detail: Q4 net sales $1.42-1.44B, non-GAAP EPS $1.77-1.83 (includes closed STG and Epiq and their financing costs; excludes ILFA, Merlin, Ophir). The hunt's implied organic Q4 bar was ~$1.43B, so the headline guide matches it only with acquisitions in: organic Q4 likely below that bar. Preliminary FY27 net sales $6.5-6.75B, non-GAAP EPS $8.10-8.90 (street FY27 not found). Book-to-bill 2.13, A&D backlog $2.0B. Net leverage 2.8x pro forma at 09-30.

guidance.detail: FY26 to $4.47-4.49B / EPS $4.97-5.03 from ~$4.4B / EPS approaching $5.00, but the new range includes Epiq/STG while the old one excluded deals, so the organic FY is roughly maintained or slightly lower; FY27 preliminary given for the first time.

call.detail: Call started 08:30 ET and runs to about 09:30; its content was not reviewed in time. The pre-market traded down from a $101 high to $79-82 while it ran, so the call (or the organic read of the Q4 guide) is the most likely source of the sell-off. Not verified.

public_reaction.summary: One search for this morning's price headlines found nothing from today. No analyst actions found in the time available.

tape_read.vs_implied_move: beyond (about 2.1x the 9.19% option-implied move, in the opposite direction to the release read)
tape_read.note: Robust reference $82.50 (-19.2%) against a $102.15 prev close. Pre-market range $79.00-$101.00, so it opened near flat-to-up and then sagged during the call. It is active: 136 prints, 27 in the last 30 minutes, last print 09:17, not stale. Market -0.9% (SPY). My release read was +12%, so the tape disagrees by about 31 points. Either the call or the organic Q4 read broke it, or the move is overdone; I could not tell which.

thesis_check.note: The reported quarter confirms the thesis: revenue beat by 6%, EPS beat by 17%, book-to-bill 2.13. The Epiq-diluted Q4 guide was the risk the judges named, and the market is treating it, or something on the call, as decisive.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and not stale, so the open should hold most of the -19%. A gap of twice the implied move against a release that is beat-and-raise on its face tends to give part of it back in the first half hour, but the call ends around the open and I do not know what it said.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zelf zijn sterk: omzet en winst ruim boven verwachting en een eerste vooruitzicht voor 2027. Toch staat het aandeel voorbeurs zo'n 19% lager, twee keer de beweging die de opties verwachtten, waarschijnlijk door de toon van het gesprek met analisten of de groei zonder overnames. Zo'n grote daling tegen goede cijfers in herstelt vaak deels in het eerste halfuur, dus verkoop om 10:00 en niet bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als voor 09:30 een bericht verschijnt dat in het gesprek iets echt slechts is gezegd (bijvoorbeeld een klant die wegvalt of een lagere organische prognose), of als de koers voorbeurs verder zakt onder $79, verkoop dan direct bij de opening.
